sources.title: Finding Angles for Quantum Signal Processing with Machine Precision
sources.authors: Rui Chao, Dawei Ding, Andras Gilyen, Cupjin Huang, Mario Szegedy
sources.relevance: Constructive classical algorithms for recovering QSP angle sequences from admissible target polynomials; demonstrates machine-precision phase recovery for high degrees.

sources.title: Efficient phase-factor evaluation in quantum signal processing
sources.authors: Yulong Dong, Xiang Meng, K. Birgitta Whaley, Lin Lin
sources.relevance: Optimization-based QSP phase-factor evaluation in standard double precision, including reported demonstrations beyond degree 10000.

sources.title: pyqsp - Python quantum signal processing
sources.checked_state: Public repository and PyPI documentation inspected on 2026-09-13
sources.relevance: Public software route for phase-angle generation; not yet imported as a repository dependency in Batch 037.

boundary: These sources establish available phase-synthesis methods. Batch 037 does not claim that a phase sequence for its degree-81 candidate has already been synthesized or independently verified.
